thread:
DesignLead: short sync: finalizing microcopy and behavior for the cluster landing pages and breadcrumb changes. primary asks: 1) what appears on the cluster landing? 2) how do breadcrumbs behave for shared/legacy links? 3) accessibility edge cases.
ProductPM: landing page should be query-first: search + create CTA + recent items. People expect a searchable list as soon as they land. Also the share dialog must show canonical path (no UI state).
FrontendEng: agreed. implementation plan: landing at `/workspaces/:id/deployments` shows header, search box, quick actions row, then recent list. We'll keep legacy aliases mapped to canonical path server-side. share dialog uses server mapping to display canonicalHref.
RouterEng: alias plan: manifest with alias -> canonical. Edge rewrite preferred to minimize client redirects. We'll emit header `X-Original-Path` for 21 days for debugging and analytics. Also recommend recording `nav_alias_resolved` event (original hashed + canonical).
A11yEngineer: breadcrumbs: use pattern Workspace > ClusterName > Resource > Tab. If user lands via legacy link, announce via `aria-live=polite`: "You're viewing Deployments in Workspace Gamma". Ensure cluster chip is keyboard-focusable and heading elements exist on landing pages.
UXResearch: microtests: users scanned for the landing search and missed it when buried. Also landing pages help orientation and reduce 'where did it go' tickets. Label preference: "Deployments" (noun) over "Deploy" (verb).
DesignLead: migration banner copy options? current draft: "We updated the sidebar to group related pages. Find your pages under the new sections. [Show me] [Dismiss]" Thoughts on tone?
ProductPM: keep explanatory tone and an inline "Show me" guided highlight. A/B test an alternative concise banner: "Sidebar reorganized ind Deployments under 'Deployments'."
FrontendEng: small UX detail: if users hit an alias we show the banner only once (cookie) and offer a 'Go to canonical' button that updates address bar without reload via history.replaceState. Also preserve query params that matter (filters), strip UI-only params.
RouterEng: avoid collisions: reserve cluster prefixes `deployments`, `models`, `observability`, `admin`. We'll add validation in onboarding so resource slugs cannot equal reserved words. If a collision exists we map with `/r/:id` fallback.
A11yEngineer: keyboard shortcuts: prefer chorded `mod+k` then letter (e.g., `mod+k` then `d` for Deployments) to avoid conflicts on non-latin layouts. Expose shortcut cheat sheet in Help modal and allow turning off shortcuts in prefs. Also ensure tooltips are accessible via focus.
UXResearch: internationalization note: some locales have long cluster labels. show short label in crumb and full label in tooltip; landing heading shows full localized title. Also ensure right-to-left flows tested.
DevExBot: created RDW-7601: cluster-landing + alias-manifest. Subtasks: RDW-7601a landing mock, RDW-7601b alias manifest RFC, RDW-7601c a11y checklist, RDW-7601d migration banner A/B.
DesignLead: ok owners: FrontendEng mock landing + guided tour, RouterEng produce alias manifest and reserved prefix list, A11yEngineer produce checklist, UXResearch run two quick remote tests. We'll reconvene after mocks. Thanks all :sparkles:
